name: Skyslumbre
biography: Couatlis lunaris. A moonlit celestial serpent, invisible except in moonlight or during an eclipse, that lulls whole camps into slumber under its glow. Habitat: Jungle.

features.name: Lost in Light
features.description: The skyslumbre is Invisible except when in moonlight or during a solar or lunar eclipse.

features.name: Undetectable
features.description: The skyslumbre is Immune to Divination magic and any spell or effect that would detect its thoughts, emotions, or location.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Ability: Wisdom; DC: 15; Modifier: +7. The skyslumbre requires no spell components to cast the following spells.

At Will: Dancing Lights (C), Faerie Fire (C), Guiding Bolt, Moonbeam (C), Moonveil* (C)

1/Day: Gate (C) (Astral Plane only)

*See the Spells page of the Field Notes PDF; (C) indicates Concentration.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The skyslumbre makes one Bite attack and one Constrict attack.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

features.name: Constrict
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is Restrained, and the skyslumbre can't constrict another target.

features.name: Moonlit Glow (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: Saving Throw: DC 15 Wisdom, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the skyslumbre. Failure: The target falls Unconscious for 10 minutes, until it takes damage, or until another creature within reach of it takes an action to wake it.
